headline: A strategic course correction

highlights: Management struck an upbeat tone on exports and the non-SLCM segment, while it evaluates opportunities in the South American market.
In Q2FY27, SLCM volumes grew 6% YoY to 1,186 (nos.), which led to revenue of INR 4.9bn (+10% YoY), EBITDA of INR 515mn (+14% YoY) and PAT of INR 509mn.
Raw materials (RM) cost rose 5% YoY, which remains a key margin headwind.
In-line print Ajax reported revenues of INR 4.9bn (+10% YoY).
